counterfactual.change: Reduced controller fmax from 42.95 to 5. Same steps, same wall, same dt. Removing sustained large push allows collision correction to keep body outside wall, so no_wall_penetration passes.

explanation: Controller-driven body (hover, ignores gravity) is pushed left at ~9.3 m/s into a thin vertical wall (w≈0.346) with fmax≈42.95 at vcmd≈11.46. The collision resolver uses impulses plus positional correction, but with persistent force and 2 substeps per dt≈0.004 it fails to eject the body. Penetration grows from 0.062 at step 350 to 0.138 at step 352 to 0.175 at step 353, exceeding the 0.15 limit. Lowering fmax to 5 removes the failure, confirming sustained controller force overcomes the wall correction.
vision_note: The red body attempts to move left past a tall thin vertical wall toward a green waypoint on the far side. From step 350 to 353 it does not go around the wall but instead lodges into and increasingly overlaps the top edge of the wall.
